create_compose_pipeline: create a Compose pipeline to apply multiple transforms sequentially on a data dict
build_base_dataset: build a BaseDataset subclass to load annotations from a JSON file with data_list and metainfo
get_data_info_by_index: get the data info dict for a given index from a fully initialized BaseDataset instance
filter_dataset_subset: filter a BaseDataset to a subset using get_subset or get_subset_ with integer or list indices
serialize_dataset_data: serialize a BaseDataset data_list into shared memory bytes and address arrays for multi-worker loading
